m.d: Oil is a liquid that is burned to create heat or used in machines to make them run well.
m.e: Gas and oil are essential to running a car.

m.d: Oil is a liquid made of fat that is used for cooking.
An oil is a painting made of oil paint.
If you oil something, you put clear oil on a machine to make it run well.
m.e: She oiled the parts of the gun.

m.d: An ointment is a smooth oily medicinal substance, or a cosmetic substance that you rub on your skin, usually to ease pain.
m.e: The first aid personnel applied ointment on the injured athlete.

m.d: If something is oily it is covered with or contains oil.
m.e: My face gets really oily sometimes.
